propositions: Rebar project exhibits high trigger false-positive rate (35.3% combined: 13.3% from committed high-precision tier + 22.0% from noisy concurrency tier) due to multi-process writers, file locks, and git-backed store patterns
Three corpus bugs trigger only via noisy-tier concurrency vocabulary (.lock, retry, Popen), making the project overlay load-bearing for defect detection in this repo
The two-layer trigger design (committed high-precision vs project-specific noisy vocabulary) lacks documentation, blocking other projects from adopting the same pattern
Project overlay entry must merge additively into committed routing via effective_routing key-level merge, with trigger_tokens and applies_to globs specified without redundant tokens

Configuration change must be validated through config-effect testing: diffs containing project-only tokens (index.lock) must fire overlays when routing includes project extension, but not under committed-only mode
